Décalcomanie de Reich et Ligeti (avec Piazzola en surimpression),2005, for alto saxophone and piano, seven minutes. Commissioned by Société Internationale Adolphe Sax for the2006 Dinant competition semifinal; dedicated Philippe Leblanc.

Composer note describes repetition subjected to rhythmic, harmonic, melodic and timbral changes, a cadenza exploring extreme registers and special sounds, then a tango-associated final section. These are composer descriptions, not inspected notation.
PM Europe edition FAF007, ISMN9790803751063, is indexed by specialist retailer; school library lists Tienen2006 publication.
